title: Singular affirmative yes/no questions
focus: Form olenko, oletko, and onko questions for singular persons.

exercises.instruction: Choose the best question form.
exercises.prompt: Complete “Am I at home in the morning?” ____ minä kotona aamulla?
exercises.explanation: Olen takes the question suffix -ko to form olenko.

optionFeedback.olenko: Correct. Olen takes the question suffix -ko to form olenko.
optionFeedback.oletko: “oletko” does not fit this subject or construction. Olen takes the question suffix -ko to form olenko.
optionFeedback.onko: “onko” does not fit this subject or construction. Olen takes the question suffix -ko to form olenko.

sentenceExplanation.translation: Am I at home in the morning?

parts.role: question verb: begins the yes/no question and carries person agreement
parts.formation: olen + -ko forms olenko

parts.role: subject: the person or people described by the sentence
parts.formation: subject pronoun; no ending is added

parts.role: context: tells the location or state
parts.formation: supplied as a complete fixed expression; no change is required
